theorems.name: Submission.exists_translated_varifold_allardHypotheses
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ξ : Amb n ℓ), ∃ V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => x - ξ) '' U), V'.carrier = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier ∧ (∀ x, V'.mult x = V.mult (x + ξ)) ∧ V'.weight = V.weight.map (fun x => x - ξ) ∧ V'.support = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.support ∧ (∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V'.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun x => H (x + ξ))) ∧ ∀ (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p δ r : ℝ), V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → ξ ∈ V.support → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ U → V.weight (closedBall ξ r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + δ) * (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) → V.scaledLpNorm H p ξ r ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ → V'.AllardHypotheses (fun x => H (x + ξ)) p δ r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
